parameters.content:
## CloneX takedown dispatch
Webhook (POST from /api/trigger-takedown) -> Prepare notice -> email (or Gmail draft) -> Telegram alert -> reply.

**Before publishing:** connect Gmail + Telegram credentials; set the Webhook node to Header Auth with the secret you put in N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET (header `x-clonex-secret`).

**Optional AI step:** CloneX already writes the notice text and lets the user edit it. To have an AI polish it, add an AI node between 'Takedown Webhook' and 'Prepare notice' and write its output into `body.noticeText`.

The workflow replies only after the email step succeeds, so CloneX never reports a notice as sent when it was not.
